async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product / Custom Options page state, ensure the product has:
      - Price = 769.99 (Prices tab)
      - Inventory Qty = 42 and Stock Availability = In Stock (Inventory tab)
      - Save the product (Save is the last action because it navigates away)

    All interactions use accessibility selectors only (.get_by_role, .get_by_label, .select_option).
    """
    import asyncio

    # Helper functions that rely only on accessibility selectors
    async def try_click_link(name, timeout=2000):
        try:
            el = page.get_by_role("link", name=name).first
            await el.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await el.click()
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_fill_label(labels, value, timeout=1500):
        # Try a few label variants; fills the first visible matching input
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                loc = page.get_by_label(lbl).first
                await loc.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await loc.fill(value)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox(names, option_label, timeout=1500):
        # Try named comboboxes first, fallback to the first combobox on the page
        for name in names:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name).first
                await cb.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        try:
            cb_any = page.get_by_role("combobox").first
            await cb_any.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await cb_any.select_option(label=option_label)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    # Let UI settle
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

    # 1) Switch to Prices tab and set Price to 769.99
    # Reason: Price is under the Prices tab. Use link role to switch tab.
    await try_click_link("Prices")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
    await try_fill_label(["Price *", "Price"], "769.99")

    # 2) Switch to Inventory tab and set Qty and Stock Availability
    await try_click_link("Inventory")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
    # Fill quantity (try common label variants)
    await try_fill_label(["Qty", "Qty *", "Quantity", "Quantity *"], "42")
    # Set stock availability to In Stock
    await try_select_combobox(["Stock Availability", "Stock Availability *", "Stock Status"], "In Stock")

    # 3) Save the product (final action - will navigate away)
    # Prefer explicit top-level Save button; fallback to other save buttons
    try:
        save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first
        await save_btn.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=1500)
        await save_btn.click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").first.click()
        except Exception:
            try:
                # last resort: click the first button on the page
                await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # Allow save/navigation to start
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
